refund_policy.faulty_item_policy: Under Australian Consumer Law, customers are entitled to a repair, replacement or refund for a major failure, regardless of the manufacturer's warranty period.

warranty_policy.note: Australian Consumer Law guarantees apply in addition to, and are not limited by, any manufacturer or retailer warranty.

escalation_rules.discount_requests: Any discount or goodwill offer must be approved by a CSR supervisor before being communicated to the customer.
escalation_rules.replacement_requests: Replacement approvals for orders over $500 AUD require supervisor sign-off.
